expected_root_cause: A bounded transport delay was introduced only on the order-service to product-service dependency path.
expected_symptoms: Order creation remains functional but its response latency increases significantly.
Slow product-service dependency spans are visible in traces.
Unrelated user-service and direct product-service requests remain responsive.
expected_evidence: Prometheus request-duration histogram and p95 latency increase for order-service.
Jaeger traces contain long-running order-service and product-service client spans.
HTTP order requests complete successfully but more slowly than baseline.
Direct product-service requests remain at baseline latency.
expected_resolution: Restore normal transport behavior on the affected dependency path and verify latency returns to baseline.

timeline.event: Capture normal order-service latency and trace durations.
Apply a bounded transport delay only to the product-service dependency path.
Order latency rises while successful responses and unrelated dependency traffic continue.
Remove the tc qdisc and confirm latency and traces recover.
